## Portfolio Rules

- Application-area files own requirement content and their local indexes.
- This file owns cross-area totals and links.
- Additions and status or stage changes update the area index, then regenerate
  this portfolio index with `./scripts/update_requirements_index.py`.
- Requirement IDs are stable and never reused.
- Only the repository owner accepts, defers, rejects, reprioritizes, or moves a
  requirement between delivery stages.
